items.title: Jensen Huang’s departure may signal tighter US controls on AI chip exports to China
items.summary:
Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang’s abrupt departure has raised fresh questions about the future of US-China technology ties, as observers weigh the potential fallout from Washington’s policy on advanced AI chip exports to China.
The timing is particularly sensitive, with US lawmakers debating an annual defence authorisation bill amid growing calls to tighten restrictions on China’s access to advanced AI chips.

items.title: aws-emulator
items.summary:
aws-emulator
Finally, an official emulator from AWS to run tests against a local clone of their many different services without having to provision a paid API key to do so.
It's written in Rust by a huge swarm of agents - 29,684 commits in the first three weeks of the project. Swaminathan (Swami) Sivasubramanian wrote about how it came to be in a guest post on Werner Vogels' blog.
It currently requires Docker to run on macOS or Windows. I'm hoping they fix that in the future - it would be great
